first_party._comment: Paths (or path prefixes) that are ours. No record needed beyond being listed here. A path with an explicit third_party record is still validated as third-party even if it sits under one of these prefixes -- otherwise a first-party directory would launder anything dropped into it.
first_party._comment_sigmaudio: Condi's five-weapon SigmAudio set (handoff/five_weapon_audio/, copied unchanged into godot/audio/sigmaudio/five_weapons/ by tools/five_weapons/import_sigmaudio.py) is authored in SigmAudio from its own synthesis and its bundled public-domain and CC0 recordings: Salamander drum kit (public domain, Alexander Holm), TR-808 (CC0, Michael Fischer), VSCO 2 Community Edition percussion (CC0, Versilian Studios), Kenney interface sounds (CC0). No recorded firearms; no attribution is required. Candidate audio, not approved; see the handoff README.
first_party._comment_music: Condi's approved music for the unified build (handoff/approved_music_v1/ on PR #44, 124d9467, copied unchanged into godot/audio/music/; see its PROVENANCE.json). Authored in SigmAudio: the station cue from SigmAudio's own synthesis and bundled instruments (no recorded samples); the Freight Bay cue and stingers from 14 Freesound recordings, each CC0 1.0, Karoryfer Samples' Black And Green Guitars (CC0 1.0) and SigmAudio's bundled public-domain rockKit. Each recording's link, creator and edits are in the handoff's freight_bay/SOURCES.md and sample-manifest.json. No attribution is required.
first_party._comment_weapon_art: Arty's five weapon models, lean maps and Glyph effect sheets (branch claude/archipepsi-art-weapon-integration-2026-10-14, a5d322f9; see godot/content/weapons/PROVENANCE.json), authored by the project's art lane with Claude and approved by the owner for the unified build.
first_party._comment_shunter_sfx: Condi's Shunter sound set v1 (handoff/shunter_sfx_v1/ on draft PR #45, b1235032, copied unchanged into godot/audio/sigmaudio/shunter/; see its PROVENANCE.json): seven candidate sounds cut and layered by Condi from CC0 1.0 Freesound recordings (each listed with link, creator and edits in the handoff's SOURCES.md and sample-manifest.json), plus shunter_horn.wav, a byte-identical copy of the horn recorded under third_party below. No attribution is required.

approved_licenses._comment: Safe by default per D2. Anything not here needs an explicit owner decision.

_comment: Named so a refusal explains itself rather than just failing.
An NC or ND asset is not a judgement call to be made in a hurry
at commit time; a marketplace asset that may ship in a compiled
build but not be redistributed as source is the trap D2 calls out
specifically, because it looks fine until the repo is public.
refused_licenses.CC-BY-NC: non-commercial; incompatible with an open release
refused_licenses.CC-BY-ND: no-derivatives; we modify assets as a matter of course
refused_licenses.unknown: no licence is not a permissive licence
refused_licenses.ripped: extracted from another game; never acceptable
refused_licenses.ai-service-unclear: third-party AI output with unclear terms
refused_licenses.marketplace-no-redistribution: usable in a compiled build, but the raw asset may not live in a public repository
